reason: TypeScript 6.0.3 reports nothing for /// <amd-module name="..." /> (its only check of the directive is the duplicate-name error 2458, no deprecation suggestion) and still names the define() call under module amd with ignoreDeprecations "6.0", while every other module value ignores the directive in 5.8, 6.0 and 7.0 alike, so only module=AMD itself is signaled (TS5107, a separate entry) and a test cannot tell code with the directive from code without it.
The 6.0 deprecation of outFile is the same change as its 7.0 removal, already built as ts-upgrade-storefront-scripts (typescript@7.0.2/remove-outfile).

In 7.0.2 the directive is silently ignored under every module value tsc still accepts (no diagnostic with commonjs or esnext), and it only ever named the define() emitted for module amd/umd/system, whose removal (TS5108) is what breaks a 5.8 project that used it: the same change as ts-upgrade-slug-library (typescript@7.0.2/remove-module-amd-umd-system-none).
